start: Workout tab, a routine with two weight-and-reps exercises; no workout in progress

user_sees: The workout screen with a running clock and one card per exercise
A PREVIOUS value on each set row from the last workout
must_not: Sets of another workout prefilled as done
The clock starting at a time other than now

steps.action: Type weight and reps on set 1 and tick it
user_sees: The row ticked
The rest timer starts
must_not: The typed numbers lost if the app is closed right after (saved 300 ms after typing and at once on a tick)

steps.action: Mark one row as a warm-up and one as a drop set; with 'Rate how hard each set felt' on, rate a set
user_sees: W on the warm-up row
The rating shown on its row (for example '@8')
must_not: A warm-up counted as a working set

user_sees: Sheet 'Finish workout?' with the time and sets
Buttons 'Finish workout' and 'Keep going'
For rows not ticked: 'Leave them out' or 'Save them'
must_not: The workout saved before 'Finish workout' is tapped

user_sees: The workout summary opens
must_not: Two workouts saved after a fast double tap
The workout dated on the day it finished when it started before midnight

start: A workout in progress with 3 ticked sets; the member swipes the app away

user_sees: The Workout tab's Up next card shows the workout in progress with Resume and Discard
must_not: The workout gone
A second copy of the workout

user_sees: The same exercises, ticks, typed numbers and clock
must_not: A paused workout's clock running while the app was closed
Hints shown before the targets loaded and then jumping

start: An empty workout with a timed exercise (plank) and a distance exercise (run)

steps.action: Start an empty workout and add the two exercises
user_sees: Time boxes on the plank rows, distance and time boxes on the run rows
must_not: Weight and reps boxes on a timed exercise

steps.action: Enter 60 seconds and 2 km, tick both, Finish
user_sees: The summary shows 1:00 and 2 km
must_not: The time or distance saved as reps or weight
A ticked timed set left out of the workout

start: Workout screen with only warm-up rows ticked, or none ticked

steps.action: Tap Finish with no set ticked
user_sees: The sheet's main button reads 'Tick a set to finish'
must_not: An empty workout saved

steps.action: Finish when only warm-ups were ticked
user_sees: 'Nothing to save' with 'Tick at least one set before finishing.'
must_not: A warm-up-only workout saved that history cannot show

user_sees: 'Could not save' with 'Something went wrong saving your workout. Your sets are still here — tap Finish to try again.'
must_not: Half a workout saved
The sets wiped

start: A workout in progress; one ticked set started the running rest

user_sees: The row unticked; the rest that set started stops
must_not: The bell ringing for a set that is no longer done
Numbers filled by the tick left in a blank row

steps.action: Tap back (chevron) and choose to discard
user_sees: 'Discard workout?' with 'This workout and its sets will be deleted. This cannot be undone.', 'Discard' and 'Keep logging'
must_not: The workout discarded without the question

steps.action: Tap 'Discard', then close and reopen the app
user_sees: No workout in progress
must_not: The discarded workout coming back as a ghost after reopening

start: A member who never signed in, on the free plan

user_sees: The workout saved and shown in history; no paywall
must_not: Logging locked behind a paid plan
The workout sent to a server when the member never signed in
